name: @bahira/spear-physics-core
description: Physics primitives distilled to pure algebra - verified modules (35 grounded tests), zero dependencies. Kernels SPEAR, KAN, Ising, FEP, FFT, MZI, BPM, optics, control, drones, PNN, Langevin.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --target es2020 --lib es2020,dom --outDir dist
